newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae to redeem callable notes.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae to redeem callable notes.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Thursday it will redeem the following callable note series in their entirety as follows:

*Accrued interest of $15.4375 per $1,000 face amount will also be paid at redemption. The notes are worth a par amount of $100 million. Principal will be repaid at 100 percent of the face amount. Payment will be made to holders of record as of the close of business December 17.

**Accrued interest of $35.00 per $1,000 face amount, along with principal at 100 percent of face amount, will be paid on December 23. The notes are worth a par amount of $100 million. Payment will be made to holders of record as of the close of business December 20.
